_comment: Account-level allowlist. The exporter reads each session's account field from its meta-JSON sidecar and only proceeds if the account appears in 'accounts' below. Useful for excluding personal Cowork spaces while keeping work-account ones. Copy this file to ~/.config/nfx-cowork-export/account-allowlist.json (or Windows equivalent) and replace the example addresses with your real accounts.
_matching: Case-insensitive exact match against the meta-JSON 'emailAddress' field. No wildcards in v1.
